subject: Pilot wrap: Parcelflux performance snapshot & quick blurb request
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <amonroe@parcelflux.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@parcelflux.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap: Parcelflux performance snapshot & quick blurb request

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with us — really appreciate the tight cooperation from your infra and ops teams. Quick summary of the outcomes we captured in the attached KPI sheet:

- p95 inference latency down ~40% (from 320ms to ~190ms) on end-to-end requests
- Sustained throughput improvement: ~2.6x higher concurrent requests handled at same GPU fleet size
- Per-token compute cost down ~28% vs your baseline (quant+batching config)
- Error rate unchanged; no customer-facing regressions observed

We referenced the Parcelflux production workload (typical request length ~480 tokens) and served on the c5/rtx mixture in us-west. The attached spreadsheet has the per-day breakdown and the dashboard screenshot is included as a separate image.

Marketing is hoping to highlight Parcelflux as a short customer spotlight. Would you be comfortable with one of the following:

1) A two-line blurb we can publish (we can draft and you can tweak), plus permission to attribute Parcelflux and use your logo; OR
2) A quick 15-minute call to capture a short quote on-record and confirm the metrics/attribution.

If you prefer option 1, here is a suggested one-liner you can edit: "Parcelflux reduced inference latency by 40% and cut per-token compute cost by nearly 30% during a short POC with Redwood, enabling faster customer responses at lower cost."

Proposed times for a 15-minute call: today 3:30–4:00 PM PT or tomorrow 10:00–10:30 AM PT. If neither works, please suggest a slot.

Thanks — and happy to route any legal/compliance checks (SOC2 excerpt, DPA) if needed.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Success Lead, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: parcelflux-pilot-kpi-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), screenshot-cost-dashboard.png (image)

From: Alex Monroe <amonroe@parcelflux.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap: Parcelflux performance snapshot & quick blurb request

Evelyn — thanks for the clear summary and the spreadsheet. Nice work to your team.

Parcelflux is happy to be featured. The suggested one-liner looks good with one tweak: replace "cut per-token compute cost by nearly 30%" with "reduced compute spend per request by ~28%".

We can do a quick 15-minute call tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT to put a voice to the quote and sign off on the wording. Priya (cc'd) will join and has the final OK on logo usage.

Alex
